mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which signals reduced corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market strengthening, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding supply capacity and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600.0 for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary policy response to high inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a slow-growth regime (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized), a decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals worsening economic conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized and GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
